restores: The grant refusal in `ServeCore` settles nothing, so a GET under the same request ID with a smaller grant is admitted after its ERROR.

miss_cause.evidence: Every run of the five profiles evaluates the planted grant check of `ServeCore` (a scratch trace there panicked in all 100,903 upload, 88,633 faulted, 41,018 cluster-broad, 50,405 cluster-pressure and 48,920 cluster-swarm runs at commit 6240a6fd9), and a trace inside its refusal branch fired in none of 152,904 upload, 120,280 faulted, 33,442 cluster-broad, 12,700 cluster-pressure and 5,170 cluster-swarm runs, so no swept client asks for a grant above its session window; the planted grant check also fired in all 247,397 cluster-long runs of one 60 s sweep at commit 3a9e2b08d, and `cluster-long` stays out of `expected` because the profile has no passing run at the default counts, so it gives no verdict.
